title: Level-0 denominator reconciliation
goal: Crossread current Drive/PF manifests, exact/bounded submanifests and recent peer completion receipts; produce a non-authoritative residual-obligation matrix that distinguishes exact-recursive closed, semantic-closed/identity-open, bounded-only and fully-open obligations; identify the minimal blockers to freezing the Level-0 denominator without inventing coverage.
completion_test: Residual matrix reflects latest manifests/peer closures, records evidence refs for each resolved/open item, explicitly marks stale central projections, and routes highest-value remaining obligations; no global exact percentage awarded until denominator freeze.
